name: Grim Omen calls the Darkwing on a critical Bloodfang Bite (#3174)
contract: Grim Omen 800154 reads 'Critical strikes with Ravenous Strike or Bloodfang Bite, or using Howl spells, now triggers Call of the Darkwing'. The implementation (spell_proc row plus aura_ascension_bloodmage_grim_omen in AscensionBloodmageProcs.cpp, #4513) narrows the proc to PROC_SPELL_PHASE_HIT with PROC_HIT_CRITICAL for the strike family and PROC_SPELL_PHASE_CAST for Howls. bloodmage-grim-omen-howl covers the Howl clause; the critical-strike clause stayed unproven because the fixture had no melee critical strike control. The harness now applies melee_crit_rating through the native rating calculation, so a Bloodfang Bite 800156 (DmgClass MELEE, SpellFamilyFlags (0, 8388608, 0), CasterAuraSpell 525031) can be forced to crit deterministically. Ravenous Strike is not used here because SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_MAIN_HAND_WEAPON makes it uncastable for an unarmed fixture. A control player with the same forced crit but without Grim Omen discriminates the proc: a critical strike alone must not summon.
